newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market near steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market near steady - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were near steady in a light test, compared to Tuesday's close, USDA said.
Trade was fairly slow and demand moderate. Seller interest mostly light. Offerings current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1175-1250 lbs few 67.00-68.00 ld 66.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1200 lbs few 67.00-67.50.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared Tuesdays close - Slaughter steers and heifers steady to weak.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1175-1300 lbs 109.00 few 110.00 Holstein - (weight only) ld 108.00 Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 104.00-105.00 Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs ld 106.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 102.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1050-1200 lbs 109.00 pt ld 110.00.
